note: Fish schools (plan C, design/FISH_AND_FISHING_PLAN.md section 2 and 4): computed from a hash of (cell, slot, game day), never saved, never an entity. count_weights = chance of 0, 1, 2, 3 schools in a 128 m cell that has water. A school is placed on a point whose water kind (server_fish_water.gd) suits its species, up to place_tries tries, else it does not exist. Radius 3 to 8 m. The centre drifts drift_m metres around its base over drift_period_game_s and is held at the base when the drift would leave suitable water. factor: 1.0 inside the radius, 0.5 within 2x, far (0.03) outside (balance plan 5b: 0.15 gave about 19 fish an hour at midday to a net hauler standing outside every school; the aim is 1 to 8). species_by_kind: species names must exist as items; one that does not (salmon until the fish items land) is left out. only_in: species -> seasons it appears in.

signs.note: Fish you can see (plan D, server_fish_signs.gd; Dave 24 Nov 2026: never saw a fish pool). Once tick_ms the server rolls each school within reach_m of a player for a jump: jump_per_s for a school of big_size fish, scaled by its size, hour_mult [from, to, x] (else night_mult from 21:00 to 05:00, 1.0 by day) and the weather (rain_mult, storm_mult, cold_mult under cold_c): one jump every 10 to 30 s near a big school (plan 3.1). A player gets at most one jump per player_gap_ms. Size class: size_mid and size_big fish; big_species jump bigger. Every shadow_every_ms a player is sent the schools within shadow_m in water no deeper than shadow_depth_max_m, nearest first, at most shadow_max (plan 6.4), only when the list changed. The catch odds are unchanged.
